turns.assistant_text:
Here's what's making news on OpenAI right now:

**Funding — $11B raised at a $1.25T valuation**
OpenAI closed on roughly $11 billion in new funding as the first tranche of a round valuing the company at $1.25 trillion. It's a notable scale-back: the company had originally targeted $30B+ at a $1.4–1.5T valuation. SoftBank and MGX participated, and the round could reach ~$20B total in coming weeks. The pullback tracks a broader cooling in AI-sector sentiment.
- [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-06/openai-completes-11-billion-portion-of-funding-at-1-25-trillion-value) · [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/business/openai-secures-11-billion-funding-125-trillion-valuation-bloomberg-news-reports-2026-11-06) · [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/06/openai-reportedly-raises-an-additional-11-billion-at-a-1-25-trillion-valuation) · [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/openai-completes-11-billion-portion-205841010.html)

**Data centers — OpenAI sticks with its buildout after election backlash**
CFO Sarah Friar said the company will keep investing in AI infrastructure despite voters rejecting pro-data-center measures. Out of 41 local ballot measures across 10 states, all but one went against development or backed restrictions. OpenAI reaffirmed a pledge to cover the full cost of powering its data centers.
- [CNBC (CFO comments)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/06/open-ai-data-centers-election.html) · [CNBC (power commitment)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/05/openai-to-pay-for-data-center-power-after-election-shows-ai-concern.html)

**Security — GPT‑6 Cyber and an agentic vuln-hunting pipeline**
OpenAI introduced GPT‑6 Cyber, a model trained to find and validate exploitable vulnerabilities while staying within researcher-set scope. In a related writeup, the company said an agentic pipeline run using an upcoming cyber model reproduced 1,724 vulnerabilities in 30 hours and generated 948 working local privilege escalation exploits for a commonly used Linux distro.
- [OpenAI: GPT‑6 Cyber](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-cyber) · [OpenAI: "A thousand fewer paths to root"](https://openai.com/index/a-thousand-fewer-paths-to-root) · [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/11/openai-ai-pipeline-generates-948-linux.html)

**Also of note**
OpenAI's ~$11B figure landed the same day reports surfaced that Anthropic IPO buyers are eyeing valuations as low as $1.1T, down from ~$2T expectations a month ago — a signal that the AI trade is being repriced across the board. OpenAI has also been active on M&A (Ona, Promptfoo, Astral Software, OpenClaw among recent deals) and rolled out ChatGPT Enterprise on AWS Marketplace ([summary source](https://tavily.com/knowledge/company/p4PyTakV77G9)).

items.title: OpenAI Completes $11 Billion Portion of Funding at $1.25 Trillion Value - Bloomberg
items.summary:
OpenAI has closed on new funding of $11 billion, the initial part of a round that values the company at $1.25 trillion, according to people familiar with the matter.  
The funding was wired to the company as of Friday, said the people, who spoke on condition of anonymity as the information is not public. The remainder of the round, which could increase to as much as $20 billion in total, is expected to be completed in the coming weeks, one person said. [...] The AI developer has been in talks for more than a month to raise a large funding round after delaying its plans for an initial public offering. OpenAI initially set out to raise $30 billion or more at a $1.4 trillion valuation, Bloomberg News has reported, before scaling back its plans amid a public market rout for the AI sector.  
OpenAI declined to comment. The Wall Street Journal previously reported some details of the funding. [...] The reduced funding goals represent a stark shift for a fundraising juggernaut that helped usher in the current AI boom. The sentiment around AI has also changed dramatically since the round kicked off, due to concerns about the spending spree on physical infrastructure for artificial intelligence and the potential for new roadblocks to data center construction following the US midterm elections.  
OpenAI raised $122 billion in a March funding round at an $852 billion valuation.
